# Every git repository under ~/Documents/GIT, and what regenerates or tests it.
# A repository found there and missing here fails, and so does one named here
# and not found: this list is a claim, and the gate tests it.
#
#   repo :: kind :: command          (run from the repository root)
#
#   check  read-only; passes on exit 0
#   regen  writes in place; passes on exit 0 with the tree still clean after.
#          Runs only on a tree that was clean before, so it never touches
#          uncommitted work. A failure leaves the regenerated files in place,
#          which is the diff that shows what went stale.
#   none   nothing to run; the text says why
#
# {tools} is the lasermade-tools directory; its programs are in {tools}/target/release.

atomic-layer-memory :: regen :: python3 tools/redraw.py images/atomic_i_redrawn.png
atomic-layer-memory :: regen :: python3 tools/redraw_rgb.py images/atomic_i_rgb.png

bang-for-the-buck :: none :: a cleanup tool run on a full drive; it writes nothing committed

coprime-intervals :: regen :: python3 coprime_intervals.py

gernreich-writing :: none :: a hand-written page with no generator

gray-and-de-bruijn :: check :: python3 walks.py --check

harmonics :: check :: python3 harmonics.py --check

hex-dice-box :: regen :: python3 hex_dice_box.py

knot-crossings :: check :: python3 knot_crossings.py --check

lapping :: none :: a hand-written page with no generator

Logic-Research :: check :: python3 ANN/test_nncore.py
Logic-Research :: check :: python3 python/test_boolean16.py
Logic-Research :: check :: cargo test --release -q --manifest-path gates-of-gates/Cargo.toml
Logic-Research :: regen :: python3 zellweger/build_page.py
Logic-Research :: regen :: python3 gates-of-gates/tools/build_document.py {tools}/target/release/md2html
# Not here: python3 ANN/build_viewers.py --check. It reads ANN/generated_clouds/,
# about 200 million sampled points that are gitignored and made by the
# generate_clouds.py commands in ANN/README.md, so a fresh checkout cannot run it.

windbag :: regen :: python3 bundle_tunes.py
